title: an-agreement-check-proves-both-halves-can-red
intention: MUTATION TESTING, narrowed to two-input agreement checks. An agreement check DECLARES its two sides; the harness corrupts side A and confirms the check reds, then corrupts side B and confirms the check reds. Both must red. If only one does, the check is HALF DEAD — it is reading one input and ignoring the other — and the harness names WHICH side, because that diagnosis is the deliverable and not the pass/fail.
why:
MEASURED, and the measurement is the reason two-input checks were adopted this morning: a one-input check compares the world against an expectation, and an expectation is a constant stranded in a human's head, which is why it generates a question for its owner every time the world changes shape. Two-input agreement checks dissolve that — but Akien's immediate response on being shown the pattern was the correct objection: 'indeed two input agreement can go green but now we can also build self tests for that.' Two sides that drift together agree perfectly and say nothing.

THE LIVED SYMPTOM: a check has been green for months. It is guarding a real invariant, or it is comparing a thing to itself, and from the outside these are indistinguishable — both are silent, both are green, and the second one lets the defect it was built to catch walk straight through while the build reports success. This is not hypothetical here: the local family is already on file, checks that go green for the wrong reason (whole-record substring scans that match anything, vacuous fixtures), so the instrument has a founding instance rather than a worry.

WHY THE NARROWING IS WHAT MAKES IT BUILDABLE. General mutation testing needs a mutation-operator library and a way to distinguish equivalent mutants — a research problem. Two-input agreement checks have a trivially enumerable mutation set (corrupt A, corrupt B) and an unambiguous expectation (both must red). That is a complete, decidable instrument over a specific check shape: a build, not a project.
traces_to: Ruling 2026-08-14-corrosion-is-drift-with-no-ruling-behind-it — Akien's 'we can also build self tests for that', the deterministic half of the corrosion program

Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass. This is Law 8's INSTRUMENT: the standard is stated, a human currently judges hollowness, and this decides it mechanically for one check shape.
Law 4 — prose becoming physics, which is the direction of travel for every rule here
Law 3 — 'this proof is sound' is an unmeasured claim until something has tried to make it fail
Borrow patterns, cite don't graft — mutation testing is a field technique, cited and composed, no bytes taken

falsifier.proves_green: PROVE GATE — tester teeth: a healthy agreement check reds under BOTH mutations; a deliberately half-dead fixture (ignores side B) reds under mutation A and NOT under B, and the harness NAMES side B — the discrimination tooth, which a hollow build would collapse into a single boolean; a check declaring no sides is REFUSED rather than skipped; the harness mutates the check's INPUTS and not the checker, exercised directly; an unmutatable input is RECORDED as unmutated and does not count as covered. BUILD GATE — build_inspector at the PROVEME crossing. DURABILITY GATE — committed to both repos. KICKS BACK ON — red routes to build at the point of creation (CP2).
falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) an agreement check whose halves are both live passes mutation while a check with a dead half also passes — no discrimination, which is the whole instrument; (2) the harness reports a single pass/fail instead of naming WHICH side failed to red; (3) agreement checks are identified by inspecting code rather than by declaration; (4) the mutation is applied to the CHECK rather than to its inputs — mutating the checker tests the harness, and it is the easy wrong version; (5) a check that legitimately cannot be mutated is silently skipped rather than recorded as unmutated, which lets coverage look total while shrinking.
falsifier.horizon: Alongside or after `the-proof-record-persists-so-runs-can-be-compared` — 'mutation ran and both halves redded' is a per-run result, and a per-run result is worthless unless comparable across runs. It can be built before that lands; its output cannot be trusted over time until it does. Behind the chart floor build order Akien set the same day.
